fields.FIR_Description: During the afternoon of 2025-01-26, around 13:25, members of a chit group near Sindhu Garden Residential Colony reported that the organiser stopped payouts, with the complainant owed about Rs. 1,85,000, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-02-12. The online submission was made by Rakesh Anand (9000000340). Yuvaraj Palanisamy (9000000158) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complainant alleged that Arun Babu may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000379. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100069 as the destination of the transfer. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a bank transaction reference and physical documents. The account SYN-ACC-100069 was also referenced in FIR-2026-00007, so the two matters may be potentially related.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Organiser allegedly stopped payouts and became unreachable.
fields.Keywords: chit fund, financial fraud, residential colony, afternoon, receiving account, witness, mobile number, bank reference
